_comment: GENERATED by Tools/environment/terrain_textures.py - layer order of the runtime terrain texture array. Each set lives in <name>/ (T_<name>_*.png + <name>.json); replace the PNGs and the JSON (tile_m, relief_m) to swap in scanned sets.

layers.name: GrassGround
layers.use: grass sward under the instanced grass (meadows, verges, lawns)

layers.name: MeadowLitter
layers.use: dry meadow soil with fallen leaves (under broadleaf trees, dry slopes, along walls)

layers.name: ForestFloor
layers.use: spruce needle litter, cones, moss (forest outside the soft boundary)

layers.name: Dirt
layers.use: compacted field-track / path soil with pebbles

layers.name: Mud
layers.use: wet mud (ditches, brook banks, charlie spawn), puddles in the lows

layers.name: Asphalt
layers.use: worn asphalt with aggregate, cracks, sealed cracks and a patch (wet state in the shader)

layers.name: Concrete
layers.use: broom-finished concrete slabs with joints (yard, drive, bridge approaches)

layers.name: PavingSetts
layers.use: granite setts of the village square

layers.name: RiverStones
layers.use: rounded brook-bed / bank stones with silt
